changelog:
fund-report-talking 0.1.1

- Initial release: transforms a fund quarterly report highlight sheet and approved still images into 2–8 short talking video clips, one per still.
- Each video clip voices only facts already present on the supplied highlight sheet; no fabricating data or recommendations.
- Handles collection of required inputs—highlight sheet, images, pronunciation, consent, and pack size—with prompts for any missing data.
- Clearly separates paid workflow stages for voice cloning, speech synthesis, and video creation, with explicit consumer-facing pricing, credits, and policy handling at each step.
- Emphasizes planning and transparent slot listing before payment, with robust error and consent checks before advancing.
- Designed for advisors or marketers needing short, factual, image-based video summaries of fund quarterly reports.
summary: Turn a user-supplied fund quarterly report highlight sheet and authorized stills into one fund quarterly report talking clip per still. This fund quarterly report talking video studio writes a speakable report-fact talking clip for each photo, then animates a 2 to 15s quarterly highlight talking clip. Use it for fund quarterly report talking packs that stay one photo, one clip.
